
'''Ōyamazumi Shrine''' (大山祇神社, Ōyamazumi Jinja)

According to a 1995 survey by the Association of Shinto Shrines, there were 293 shrines, while a 2019 study by {{ill|Kanazawa Institute of Technology|ja|金沢工業大学|zh|金泽工业大学|qid=Q6360885|lt=Kanazawa Institute of Technology}} reported 960 shrines. The shrine may also be written as '''Ōyamazumi Shrine''', '''Ōyamatsumi Shrine''', '''Yamazumi Shrine''', or '''Yamatsumi Shrine'''.

The head shrine is the {{ill|Ōyamazumi Shrine|ja|大山祇神社 (今治市大三島)|lt=Ōyamazumi Shrine (Ōmishima)}} in [[:en:Ōmishima|Ōmishima]], [[:en:Imabari|Imabari]], {{ill|Ehime Prefecture|en|Ehime Prefecture|qid=Q123376|lt=Ehime Prefecture}}. Other related shrine names under the [[Mishima–Ōyamazumi cult]] include {{ill|Mishima Taisha|ja|三島神社|qid=Q11355275|lt=Mishima Shrine}}.
